openings.claim: Removable lateral abutments could resist sliding without increasing the corner compression associated with opposite-corner lift.
openings.delta: Change the sideways reaction carrier from seal friction to two rubber-padded, bolted strip assemblies gripping the external rim and bearing against hatch edges. Use four supplied strips; drill only strips. Any overlapping retainer must swivel completely clear for opening. Tether detachable hardware with supplied cord.
openings.prediction: If lateral restraint dominates, abutments should reduce displacement toward the 1 mm limit under 20 N without needing increased corner pressure. The nearest rival is retention through added compression and friction; that predicts improvement only with greater pressure, potentially accompanied by opposite-corner lift. These differences are proposed, not observed.
openings.probe: First check external rim access, bolt reach and clearance with supplied ruler and parts. If viable, allocate two untreated closure/pull trials, one disturbed, then ten opening/closure/pull cycles with the assembly, disturbing the final closure. Record marked displacement, opposite-corner lift, reopening time and new visible seal tears. Compare with the supplied 4 mm untreated displacement. Stop fabrication if secure external attachment requires altering the fixture.
assumptions: Unknown rim geometry permits the supplied strips and bolts to grip externally without permanent deformation or obstructing the marked opening.
Available strip stiffness, pad friction and edge geometry can carry 20 N; neither capacity nor reproducible clamp adjustment is established.
Fabrication fits ninety minutes and twelve trials fit twenty minutes; one technician can swivel retainers within thirty seconds.

Defeat: abutments slip, the hatch rotates beyond 1 mm, disturbance prevents closure, seal tears, or clearing hardware exceeds thirty seconds. A clamping-slip result leaves load-carrier failure and insufficient capacity unresolved.

assessment: One conditional mechanism probe, with uncertain physical fit. Passing requires every stated outcome after ten cycles, including the final disturbance except seal continuity. The compressed rival receives no dedicated configuration here; corner-lift observations can challenge it but cannot establish its full performance. The trial cap does not establish feasibility. No deployment or measured improvement is claimed.
